mapper.sql: s.scope_id, s.storage_id, s.bucket_name, s.object_prefix AS scope_prefix, s.state, b.binding_type, b.tenant_id, b.object_prefix AS binding_prefix, b.file_group_code, b.manifest_key_template, b.channel_code, b.enabled
mapper.select: SELECT FROM batch.import_ingress_ownership s LEFT JOIN batch.import_ingress_ownership_binding b ON b.scope_id = s.scope_id AND b.enabled WHERE s.scope_id = #{scopeId} AND s.state = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.scope_id, b.binding_type, b.tenant_id, b.object_prefix

SELECT FROM batch.import_ingress_ownership s LEFT JOIN batch.import_ingress_ownership_binding b ON b.scope_id = s.scope_id WHERE s.storage_id = #{storageId} AND s.state IN ('ACTIVE', 'RETIRED') ORDER BY s.scope_id, b.binding_type, b.tenant_id, b.object_prefix
